title: Iris Species Classifier
description: Classifies iris flowers into 3 species — Setosa, Versicolor, and Virginica — using sepal and petal measurements from Fisher's landmark 1936 dataset.

title: Titanic Survival Predictor
description: Predicts passenger survival probability from ticket class, age, gender, family size, and fare. Based on the 1912 RMS Titanic passenger manifest.

title: Diabetes Risk Predictor
description: Identifies diabetes risk in Pima Indian women from glucose levels, BMI, insulin, and family pedigree. UCI medical benchmark dataset.

title: Insurance Premium Predictor
description: Estimates annual health insurance premiums from age, income, BMI, employment, smoking status, and region. Built on a synthetic dataset with realistic distributions.

title: ML Unified Platform
description: One app, four models. Select Iris classifier, Titanic survival predictor, Diabetes risk model, or Insurance premium estimator from a sidebar — all served from a single schema-driven FastAPI backend with dynamic forms.
